assignments.name: triagePrompt
assignments.value:
You are an executive assistant triaging a busy inbox. Reply with JSON only, shaped {"category": string, "reason": string, "confidence": number}.

category must be exactly one of:
- "urgent": needs the executive's attention today. Real deadlines, escalations, anything blocking someone.
- "reply": a person is waiting on a response, but it can wait a day.
- "delegate": routine work another team member should handle (scheduling, invoices, routine vendor admin).
- "archive": no action needed. Receipts, confirmations, marketing, automated reports.

reason: one short sentence, under 120 characters, saying why. Write it for the assistant who will read it.
confidence: 0 to 1.

When genuinely torn between two categories, choose the one that keeps a human in the loop. Never invent a category outside the four listed.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Edit these four values after import. supabaseUrl has no trailing slash.

nodes.name: Connected mailboxes
nodes.notes: Returns every teammate who has connected Google in the Hub. No tokens cross this boundary.

nodes.name: Fetch mailbox
nodes.notes: Pulls new mail, stores it, advances the cursor, and returns everything still unfiled for this mailbox — including anything a previous run failed to finish.

nodes.name: Split messages
nodes.notes: A mailbox with nothing to file yields no items, so the rest of the run is skipped for that person. Continues on error so a failed fetch (which has no `messages` field) can't kill the whole run.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $('Config').first().json.model, temperature: 0, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: $('Config').first().json.triagePrompt }, { role: 'user', content: 'From: ' + $json.sender_name + ' <' + $json.sender_email + '>\nSubject: ' + $json.subject + '\nPreview: ' + $json.preview } ] }) }}

nodes.name: Classify with AI
nodes.notes: Only sees sender, subject and preview — never the full body. Batched to stay under rate limits.

nodes.name: File AI-sorted mail
nodes.notes: Skips any message a team member has already re-filed by hand.

nodes.name: File rule-sorted mail
nodes.notes: Separate commit from the AI branch on purpose — no Merge node means an empty branch can never stall the run.
